name: Nex Point Public Company Limited
summary: Nex Point Public Company Limited designs, manufactures, and sells electronic products in Thailand. It also offers software, and application and platform for large logistics management system; property procurement services; financial technology services; and installation and consulting services for computer systems, as well as sells hardware and software products; and rents and sells buses. In addition, the company is involved in the transportation and logistics, supply assets, labor, and property rental businesses. In addition, it creates, develops, and customizes computer software for IT services. The company was formerly known as Single Point Parts (Thailand) Public Company Limited and changed its name to Nex Point Public Company Limited in May 2019. Nex Point Public Company Limited was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Samut Prakan, Thailand.
